items.title: How to Lead When You’re the CEO of CEOs
items.summary: What does it mean to be a CEO who manages four other CEOs?  It’s all just “titles, titles, titles,” says Glenn Fogel, the head of Booking Holdings.  As president and chief executive, he oversees the chief executives of Priceline, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.

items.title: Even the CEO of Booking.com Is Fed Up With Travel These Days
items.summary: Flight delays, interminable waits on the tarmac—Booking.com CEO  Glenn Fogel  knows all about travel frustrations firsthand: “You can’t believe you even bothered.”  Booking.com and sister brands like Priceline, Kayak and OpenTable are pouring hundreds of millions into AI tools to smooth out travel hiccups.  “When we start doing that,” says Fogel, who also helms parent company Booking Holdings, “that’s when I’ll feel OK, now we really are a good AI travel agent on your phone and in your pocket.”
